segments.title: Chương 273: 0275 [Ông Trần Trình Diễn]
segments.content:
The ones responsible for the opening were a pair of young men.

The He-Li duo, performing "Learning the Four Impressions."

They pretended not to see the two pairs of large flower baskets, because that was something Lao Guo would talk about after he came on stage.

This was Bian Guanyue's first time listening to crosstalk live; she had only seen it on TV programs like the "Spring Festival Gala" before.

Seeing the crosstalk performers interacting with the audience, she whispered, "Live is different from on TV. Once they get the atmosphere going, everything they say is funny."

"Have you ever heard Li Boqing's 'free-form storytelling' in Rongcheng?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Bian Guanyue shook her head. "No. But this summer vacation, while visiting old folk artists, I met a disciple of Li Boqing who was also learning from an old artist."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Who was it?"

Bian Guanyue said, "His name is Liao Jian."

Liao Jian, of course, Chen Guiliang knew him. He was the original singer of the Sichuanese version of "Bao Liu Jifen."

This guy used to be in a band with Dao Lang. Liao Jian was the lead singer, and Dao Lang was the keyboardist.

After one crosstalk act after another, Lao Guo and Yu Qian'r finally came out for the grand finale.

The two came on stage normally, but after walking past the large flower baskets, Yu Qian'r suddenly turned back. He looked like a thief, as if the flower baskets were treasure he had his eye on, repeatedly checking the spot to plan a heist for later that night.

"Hey, hey, hey, what are you doing?" Guo Degang said impatiently.

Yu Qian'r pointed at a flower basket. "There's one for me, too."

Guo Degang said, "Look at you. Never seen one before?"

Yu Qian'r said, "I have. But they were always for you. No one ever sent one to me on the side."

"Who are you trying to hint at with that?" Guo Degang said.

Yu Qian'r quickly explained, "I'm not asking the audience for flower baskets."

"Booo—"

The audience below the stage began to jeer.

Guo Degang said, "The more you say, the more it sounds like it. Don't bother explaining." He then faced the audience, "Thank you to the boss for sending Uncle Yu a pair of funeral wreaths."

Yu Qian'r corrected, "They're flower baskets."

Guo Degang said, "Thank you to the big boss for sending me that pair of flower baskets."

Yu Qian'r's brow furrowed. "How come the ones for me are funeral wreaths, but the ones for you are flower baskets?"

Guo Degang gave a mischievous grin and didn't answer, then his expression turned serious. "Thank you to the boss. Boss Zhang and Boss Deng are regulars, but this boss today is a new face. I don't know him. Just now, I made a special trip to an internet cafe. I ran there and ran back, and I'm all sweaty."

Yu Qian'r asked, "The show's about to start, what were you doing at an internet cafe? Playing games?"

Guo Degang said, "I wanted to, but the attendant wouldn't let me in."

Yu Qian'r said, "Turning away business?"

Guo Degang said, "The attendant stopped me, sized me up for a while, and said that according to national regulations, minors are not allowed in internet cafes."

"Booo—"

The audience started jeering again.

Yu Qian'r stared at Guo Degang's face. "Is there such an old-looking minor?"

Guo Degang said, "Don't be fooled by my old looks, I was actually born in the 80s."

"Booo—"

The jeering just didn't stop today.

"You're an 80s baby?" Yu Qian'r said in surprise.

Guo Degang said, "It was after '80 that I officially started learning crosstalk."

Yu Qian'r had a sudden realization. "Oh, that kind of 'after 80'."

Guo Degang said, "After a lot of pleading, I had my disciple bring my ID card, and the attendant finally let me in."

"What did you go to the internet cafe for?" Yu Qian'r asked.

Guo Degang said, "Didn't a boss send me a pair of large flower baskets? 800 yuan a pair. Since I don't know him, I wanted to search him up online."

Yu Qian'r said to the audience, "We're in the internet age now. You can find any information online."

Guo Degang shook his sleeves. "So I found a computer and sat down. And guess what? The computer was broken, its screen wouldn't turn on."

Yu Qian'r said, "Then switch to another one."

"I tried several, but none of them would light up. I was so mad!" Guo Degang looked vexed.

Yu Qian'r shared his indignation. "What kind of internet cafe is this?"

Guo Degang: "That's what I asked the attendant, what kind of internet cafe is this? Not a single machine will turn on! The attendant called me a lunatic."

Yu Qian'r commented, "Not only are the computers faulty, the service attitude is also a problem."

Guo Degang said, "I said, what's with your service attitude? The attendant said, you didn't even turn on the power, how is the computer supposed to light up?"

Some in the audience jeered, while some had already started laughing.

Yu Qian'r looked at him with disdain. "So you don't even know how to turn on a computer?"

"You think I just don't know how to turn it on? Let me tell you, I don't know how to type either!" Guo Degang said smugly.

Yu Qian'r said, "And you're proud of it."

Guo Degang continued, "I asked the attendant to help me type, to search for Chen Guiliang, the name written on the flower basket. He opened a webpage, something called 'Searching for him a thousand times in the crowd'."

Yu Qian'r said, "That's called Baidu. It's a search engine."

Guo Degang said, "Right, that's the name. The attendant typed out the name with a clatter."

Yu Qian'r said, "The attendant types pretty fast."

Guo Degang said, "So the attendant searched, and a whole bunch of Chen Guiliangs popped up. I may not know how to type, but I know how to use a mouse."

Yu Qian'r said, "My nephew is only three, and he knows how to use a mouse."

"Get outta here! Who's your nephew!"

Guo Degang pushed Yu Qian'r away. "I clicked on the first Chen Guiliang. When the webpage loaded, hey, he sells rat poison!"

Yu Qian'r was surprised. "A rat poison seller sent us flower baskets? Two pairs of large flower baskets cost 1600 yuan in total. How much rat poison does he have to sell?"

Guo Degang scratched his forehead. "I was wondering the same thing. In my early years roaming the jianghu, I also sold bruise liniment and rat poison, but I never saw any peer make big money. So I clicked on the second Chen Guiliang, and hey, he sells pig feed..."

"Hahahaha!"

The entire venue roared with laughter.

By now, everyone understood that Guo Degang was mocking Baidu's paid search ranking.

Tao Xue was a great sport, clapping her hands and shouting her approval.

At this point, Guo Degang had only just started to become famous, and the money he had earned wasn't enough to support any arrogance. Just for two pairs of flower baskets, he was able to improvise a new routine. And he wasn't the least bit afraid of offending Baidu.

He went on to talk about several more fake Chen Guiliangs, from all sorts of professions.

Yu Qian'r grew anxious. "Who on earth sent us the flower baskets?"

Guo Degang grabbed Yu Qian'r by the collar and said in a hoarse, sharp voice, "I grabbed the attendant's clothes, 'Who sent me the flower baskets! Why can't your crappy computer find it!'"

Yu Qian'r, playing the attendant, said, "What's it got to do with me? There's a problem with Baidu."

"Tell me quick, what's the problem with Baidu!" Guo Degang maintained the hoarse voice.

Yu Qian'r said, "The boss of Baidu is busy arguing with someone, he has no time to work on his search engine."

While laughing, the audience members looked around, trying to find where Chen Guiliang was seated.

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Guo Degang, still clutching Yu Qian'r, roared hysterically, "I'll dui you to death!"

"Hahaha!"

Many in the audience were laughing, but some didn't get the joke.

Zhang Guoli didn't understand and asked his wife, "Why is that line funny?"

Deng Jie said, "For the past week, the newspapers have been reporting on this every day. The follow-up news has already made it to the entertainment section. The word 'dui' is also very popular; I've even heard people on set using it. I think it has to do with an argument between Chen Guiliang and Li Yanhong."

Zhang Guoli had been very busy this year, needing to shoot three TV series and one movie.

He had already finished two of them, working himself to the bone, and had little time to read the newspaper. He finally had a bit of a break these last two days, so he came to listen to Guo Degang's crosstalk to relax.
